title: MapMatchRequest
description: A trace to match onto the road network ([`RoutingEngine::map_match`]).

MapMatchOptions.description: Map-matching parameters. Fields missing from JSON take their defaults.

alternativeCount.description: Alternative endings of the match reported, at most 8.

attributes.description:
Whether each sub-path lists the road attributes of its edges
(`MapMatchSubPath::edges`, as a route leg's) with its expected
duration, and each matched sample its edge there and the speed the
trace moved at to reach it.

backtrackPenalty.description:
Cost (negative log-likelihood) of a U-turn onto the opposing edge, at a
node or mid-edge. Formerly the penalty for moving backwards along one
edge id.

betaM.description: Scale (m) of the exponential transition in `|route - great circle|`.

breakageDistanceM.description:
A jump over this between consecutive matchable samples breaks the
trace (m).

candidateLimit.description: Candidates kept per sample: the most likely by emission.

gpsSigmaM.description: GPS noise standard deviation (m) of the Gaussian emission.

headingWeight.description:
Weight of the emission's heading term, `heading_weight * (1 - cos
delta)`.

maxConsecutiveOutliers.description: Samples in a row the match may skip as outliers.

maxCorrelationDistanceM.description:
Candidate search radius around each sample (m), widened to twice the
sample's reported accuracy.

maxSpeedMps.description:
Route distance between timestamped samples is at most this speed
times their time apart, plus twice their sigmas (m/s).

maxTimeGapS.description:
A time gap over this between consecutive matchable samples breaks the
trace (s).

outlierCost.description: Cost of skipping one sample as an outlier.

routeDistanceFactor.description:
Route searches between samples stop at this multiple of their great
circle distance, plus `route_distance_slack_m`.

transitionWeight.description:
Unused since the HMM matcher (`beta_m` weighs transitions); kept for
source compatibility.

useReportedAccuracy.description:
Whether a sample's reported accuracy, when larger than `gps_sigma_m`,
is its sigma.

oneOf.description:
A road vehicle (car, van, truck), costed close to driving time.
Private and destination-only roads only at a route's ends.

A tracked or off-road vehicle on the vehicle network: tracks are
strongly preferred, and speeds are capped (30 km/h on tracks, 42 km/h
on main roads). Private and destination-only roads only at a route's
ends.

An emergency vehicle: wheeled and tracked access, and not confined to
through roads (it may cross private and destination-only roads).

A person walking, costed close to walking time (about 5 km/h), as
Valhalla's pedestrian costing: footways, paths and streets alike.

Travel on foot that keeps to tracks and paths: the same ways as
`OnFoot`, but tracks and paths cost half as much as streets, main roads
are avoided more strongly, and the pace on tracks and paths is faster
(6–6.5 km/h).
